widget_mechanic: Calendar opens on current month; agent must click the next-month arrow N times to reach target month, then click the target date cell. The default 'do nothing' leaves the calendar at the current month, producing dates near today (wrong).

primary_inspiration.instruction: Book a bed and breakfast in Leadville, Colorado using airbnb.com July 5 - July 18. If there are no available rooms for those dates, please indicate that in your answer.
primary_inspiration.first_failure_summary: [1.4] Calendar — agent failed to advance the two-month range picker forward to July 2026 to set the July 5 → July 18 stay window.
